description: Comprehensive phonics word bank by level for 28-level system (A0-D6) aligned with Science of Reading

A0.name: Concept of Print
A0.note: No decodable words - focus on print concepts and pre-phonemic awareness

D1.name: Sentence Variety + Dialogue
words: They played outside, and we watched.
I read a book, and you drew a picture.
The cat slept, and the dog barked.
Although it was late, they kept going.
Because it was raining, we stayed inside.
If you practice, you will improve.
While the music played, children danced.

D5.name: Figurative Language
words: I've told you a million times
